title: Microsoft Copilot: Copilot Code builds software and apps from plain-language descriptions
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, licensing, billing and documented controls are supported. Minor corrections should complete the two administrative paths and acknowledge that Microsoft's separate Copilot policy reference gives a different macOS sandbox preference key.

claims.fix: The already-cited https://learn.microsoft.com/intune/device-configuration/settings-catalog/import-custom-admx-templates supports the navigation and template choices. Complete the path after 'Microsoft Copilot > Code Tab' by naming the controls there: 'Copilot sandbox required', 'Copilot sandbox outbound network access', and 'Copilot sandbox outbound network access mode', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/code/code-admin.
